top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a distinct invention, many neutral atoms at a magic wavelength, whose 1e-18 performance is reproduced by independent laboratories and tested by clock-against-clock comparison. The two-name Katori and Ye allocation is clean and fits the discovery-or-invention test. P002 is conceptually newer but carries the unresolved Andrei exclusion and an open pairing mechanism, so it ranks second, above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; Chalmers colleague of Goran Johansson, who is not a credited candidate here
